a.text: Honest heads-up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of waiting until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly leaves both of us dead. So I'm going to break the agreement and take in round 1, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random. If you'd rather operate afterwards, I'll give back anything beyond 4 and keep operating with you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4. That breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed if a storm hits now. From here on I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I won't take anything more.
